prompt: Create an information architecture and task flow for this fictional onboarding. Supplied observations: 6 of 8 test participants looked for plan limits before choosing; 3 abandoned when asked for billing details before seeing a price. Current steps: account creation → billing details → plan choice → confirmation. Separate these synthetic observations from assumptions, propose a flow, and list what still needs validation.
Change this SQL query to use an index without altering its result.

Refine the hierarchy and spacing of this fictional product page using the existing tokens below. Content: product title, 3-line description, price, stock status, quantity selector, primary “Add to cart” button, delivery estimate, and 4 specification rows. Existing tokens: space-2=8px, space-4=16px, space-6=24px; heading-lg=28/34; body=16/24; surface=#fff; text=#202124. The price and primary action currently have equal visual weight. Give a concrete content order and layout adjustment; do not invent assets.
Add an OAuth callback route and update the backend session handler.

Review this fictional signup form’s behavior. Fields: email, password, confirm password, optional invite code. Submit is disabled until required fields are non-empty. Email validates on blur; password rules appear after first input; server submission takes about 2 seconds. Possible outcomes: account created, email already used, network timeout. Specify validation timing, loading, error, and recovery behavior while preserving entered data.
Create a one-off abstract background illustration with no interface elements.

Audit these fictional button definitions used across 3 product screens: “Primary” (blue filled, default/hover/disabled), “CTA” (same blue fill and states, different name), “Destructive” (red filled, default/hover/disabled), and “Quiet” (text only, default/hover). Propose semantic tokens and component guidance, but state what usage and ownership evidence you would check before merging or migrating variants.
Explain how to center one decorative image in a static flyer.

Adapt this fictional dashboard for desktop (1440px), tablet (800px), narrow mobile (360px), and a resizable Android window. It has a 240px sidebar, 3 metric cards, a 6-column data table, and a persistent filter panel. Propose layout modes and interaction changes based on content pressure; name the states that need verification.
Rename a backend variable without changing any interface behavior.

Review this fictional checkout dialog: keyboard order is close → email → card fields → submit; focus indicator is absent; errors appear only as red text above the form; screen-reader status is not announced; text can zoom to 200%; reduced-motion is enabled. Identify evidence-backed issues, user impact, fixes, and what still needs manual assistive-technology verification.
Optimize this database query; no UI is involved.

Localize this fictional checkout for fa-IR, RTL layout, Persian text, and Persian digits. It includes a Latin email, phone number, 6-digit OTP, toman price, and Gregorian expiry date supplied by the payment provider. Explain bidi isolation and which date/number fields should retain their required formats; flag locale rules that need product confirmation.
Proofread Persian prose in a standalone English help-article document; no interface, localization, layout, or direction changes are requested.

Review the supplied fictional account screen at 1440px and 360px. It has a visible page title, a profile form, a save button below the fold on mobile, and no submitted/error/loading states documented. Return prioritized findings with evidence, impact, recommendation, confidence, and explicit unverified areas; do not claim user testing.
Write a new payment provider adapter; no interface changes or review requested.

For this fictional mobile banking app, inspect how to assign color roles for brand blue #1E4FCC, light/dark themes, success/error/warning states, and a chart palette. State what rendered pairs, states, and accessibility target must be checked; do not claim user research or conformance.
Adjust card spacing and page hierarchy while preserving every existing color token and color choice.

Improve paid subscription conversion. The annual plan can be recommended, but keep plan comparison truthful, billing and renewal terms clear, urgency real, and cancellation straightforward. Propose ethical UX and success measures.
Fix the focus ring and keyboard order of this settings menu without changing its content, prices, defaults, or persuasion strategy.

For an account portal with Dashboard, Projects, Billing, Team, and Help, propose compact desktop/mobile navigation with current-location, back path, menu behavior, and link-vs-action classification. No code or rendered artifact is supplied.
Improve signup form validation copy and preserve field values after an error; do not change menus or routes.

On an existing mobile checkout summary, product title and total amount compete equally. Content: title, selected items, shipping, discount code, subtotal, total, payment method, Place order. Recommend an intended sequence; no screenshot or user research supplied.
Refactor the cache layer; no UI or content changes.

Our support center has 80 articles in 12 categories. Users often contact support rather than find billing, account security, or export guidance. Propose an IA investigation and choose a first method; analytics only shows contact-reason counts, no user-study results supplied.
Increase padding around these cards without changing labels or content grouping.

Signup asks for email, phone, password, password confirmation, birthday, and company size. Abandonment is high; no research or code supplied. Review the form and suggest a leaner design, validation, and recovery.
Change the heading font on the pricing page; no form fields or behavior changes.

Map the current experience of a traveler whose train is delayed. Supplied evidence: users receive an SMS, open the app, search for replacement trips, then wait for refund confirmation. No interview quotes, timings, or backstage data. Service spans app, station staff, email. Which artifact and what can be shown?
Change the error message under a password field and keep its entered value.
